meta.title: Calculadora de Consumo Energético de Calentadores de Agua
meta.title_en: Water Heater Energy Usage & Heating Cost Calculator

content.shortDescription: Calcula los kilovatios-hora (kWh) y el costo mensual de calentar agua sanitaria según el número de duchas y temperatura.
content.shortDescription_en: Calculate kilowatt-hours (kWh) and monthly cost for heating domestic hot water based on shower count and temp rise.
content.longDescription: Herramienta de consumo energético del hogar. Cuantifica la energía requerida para elevar la temperatura del agua fría de red (15°C) a temperatura de confort (45°C).
content.longDescription_en: Home energy consumption tool. Quantifies energy required to raise cold inlet water temperature (15°C) to comfortable shower temperature (45°C).
howToUse: Ingresa el Número de Personas en la Vivienda.
Ingresa el Duración Media de la Ducha por Persona (minutos/día).
Ingresa el Caudal de la Alcachofa / Regadera de Ducha (Litros/minuto, ej. 9 L/min).
Consulta el Consumo Mensual de Energía (kWh) y el Costo de Agua Caliente Sanitaria ($/mes).
howToUse_en: Enter Number of Occupants in Household.
Enter Average Daily Shower Duration per Person (minutes/day).
Enter Showerhead Flow Rate (Liters/minute, e.g. 9 L/min).
View Monthly Energy Consumption (kWh) and Hot Water Heating Cost ($/month).
content.methodology: LitrosDiarios = Personas * Minutos * CaudalLpm. Energía kWh = (LitrosDiarios * 4.184 * 30°C) / 3600. CostoMensual = kWhMensuales * TarifakWh.
content.methodology_en: Daily Liters = People * Mins * FlowLpm. Energy kWh = (DailyLiters * 4.184 * 30°C) / 3600. Monthly Cost = MonthlykWh * RatekWh.

instructions: Interpreta el consumo energético mensual para agua caliente sanitaria calculado.

instructions_en: Interpret calculated monthly domestic hot water energy usage.
Compare efficiency between electric resistance tank (COP = 1) vs heat pump water heater (COP = 3.5).
Show potential savings from shortening shower time or installing low-flow aerators.

guideSections.content_html_en:
Energy Requirement: Heating 100 Liters of water by 30°C requires ~3.5 kWh of thermal energy.

Low-Flow Showerhead: Reduces water usage from 12 L/min to 6 L/min (50% energy savings).
guideSections.content_html:
Requerimiento Energético: Calentar 100 Litros de agua en 30°C requiere ~3.5 kWh de energía térmica.

Regadera Eficiente: Reduce el caudal de 12 L/min a 6 L/min (50% de ahorro energético).
